answer.reason: Both are US clinician-based healthcare service providers that serve children, but they sell different services. Pediatrix provides hospital-based physician services (neonatal, maternal-fetal, pediatric subspecialty) under partnerships with hospitals. Aveanna provides in-home nursing, therapy and hospice care. The patient group overlaps (children, with payer funding), but the care setting, clinician type and contracting buyer differ, so the two are adjacent rather than direct peers.
